question:
Select the correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

This secret will remain __between you and I.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the pronoun "I" instead of "me" after the preposition "between".
 
• Pronouns following prepositions should be in the objective case.
 
• The correct phrase should be "between you and me" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This secret will remain between you and me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "between you" **– This option is incomplete and does not address the issue in the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "among you and I" **– This option incorrectly uses "among" instead of "between" and "I" instead of "me".
 
• **Option 3: "between I and you" **– This option incorrectly uses "I" instead of "me".
